name: SetupLocalAdmin
transaction_boundary: one LLD-01 UnitOfWork after verified live-DEK/SQLCipher readiness
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; same committed command replays result, changed payload conflicts
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate -> command_receipt -> ensure LLD-02 singleton profile -> credential verifier -> audit -> commit -> issue browser session
mutations: LLD-02 singleton profile creation only if absent
secret_rules: password exists only in bounded request memory and verifier call
password/verifier/DEK never enter receipt or audit
